issues.title: A family court documented years of abuse
issues.headline: A South Carolina Family Court documented years of manipulation, deception, threats, coercion, and abuse — and the child reportedly wants no contact with Walker or his parents.
issues.summary: Walker centers his campaign on "family court reform." The court file tells a different story. The 170-page Amended Final Order in case 2019-DR-10-1147 records years of conduct that the court characterized as the psychological and emotional abuse of a child.
keyFacts: 170-page Amended Final Order from the presiding judge
Court findings include manipulation, deception, threats, coercion, and abuse over years
Court reportedly states the child wants no contact with Walker or his parents
issues.pullQuote: What Carlton paints as righteous outrage, the Court recognized as the psychological and emotional abuse of a child.
issues.takeaway: He is running on the very system that ruled against him.

issues.title: Sued for fraud and dodging child support
issues.headline: In May 2023, the mother of Walker's child sued him alleging an intentional fraud and asset-hiding scheme to avoid more than $40,000 in fees.
issues.summary: The complaint, filed by Sylvia Ashley McAdams through Hopkins Law Firm, alleges the conduct was not bookkeeping carelessness but an intentional plan — including allegations that Walker's parents were complicit, taking property from him for token sums.
keyFacts: Complaint filed May 2023 via Hopkins Law Firm
Plaintiff: Sylvia Ashley McAdams (mother of Walker's child)
Allegations: civil fraud, hiding assets, dodging child support
Reportedly more than $40,000 in fees outstanding
issues.pullQuote: According to the complaint, this wasn't just Carlton's typically sloppy bookkeeping, but an intentional scheme.
issues.takeaway: He asks voters for trust while a court is asked to rule he hid money from his own child.

issues.title: Caught using fake, AI-generated campaign images
issues.headline: Walker was confronted for trying to pass off AI-generated images as authentic campaign content.
issues.summary: Reporting documented Walker's use of artificially generated imagery in campaign materials and his attempts to present them as real — a misleading practice voters in the lowcountry should not have to tolerate.
keyFacts: AI-generated images circulated as authentic campaign content
Confronted on the practice and continued to use the images
issues.pullQuote: Walker Was Confronted For His Attempts To Pass Off AI Generated Images As Authentic.
issues.takeaway: If he will fake the photos, what else is he willing to fake?

issues.title: Jailed over code violations as a property owner
issues.headline: Walker — a North Charleston mobile home park owner — spent a night in jail over a string of code tickets, including one for letting grass grow.
issues.summary: The Post and Courier reported the jailing and noted Walker has been fined thousands of dollars by the City of North Charleston for cutting and trimming trees near his home. Voters are owed a candidate who follows local law.
keyFacts: North Charleston mobile home park owner
Spent a night in jail for a string of code tickets
Fined thousands of dollars by the City for tree work near his home
issues.pullQuote: Spent a night in jail earlier this month for a string of tickets.
issues.takeaway: He cannot keep his own property in compliance — yet wants to write the laws others must follow.

issues.title: Tied to a sitting state representative
issues.headline: Walker's family was previously represented in family court by sitting state Rep. Gil Gatch — the same lawmaker whose record on judges has come under scrutiny.
issues.summary: Reporting links the Walker family's family-court matter — heard before Judge Daniel Martin — to representation by Rep. Gil Gatch, whose own record on judicial votes has drawn coverage.
keyFacts: Rep. Gil Gatch represented the Walker family in family court
Family court matter heard before Judge Daniel Martin
Connection raised in coverage of Gatch's judicial record
issues.pullQuote: The Carlton Walker family had previously been represented by Gatch in his family court debacle.
issues.takeaway: His political ascent runs through the same insider network he says he is fighting.
